title: Proposal: Align menu and connectMenu behaviour with RIS Menu
body:
**Do you want to request a *feature* or report a *bug*?**

A feature/bug

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

When using a **menu** with **React InstantSearch**, we get this behaviour:

![2018-01-25 14 41 37](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/123822/35391093-ebcb53c2-01dd-11e8-80f2-7dd70862bb29.gif)

Steps to reproduce:

* Load the [HierarchicalMenu story](https://community.algolia.com/react-instantsearch/storybook/?selectedKind=HierarchicalMenu\&selectedStory=default\&full=0\&addons=1\&stories=1\&panelRight=1\&addonPanel=storybooks%2Fstorybook-addon-knobs)
* Click on Lighting
* Type/search "boholmen"

**But** when using a **menu** with **InstantSearch.js**, we get this behaviour:

![2018-01-25 14 56 26](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/123822/35391785-ff9b4e1e-01df-11e8-969c-39fcb7623c26.gif)

Steps to reproduce:

* Load the [example](https://codesandbox.io/s/8zpoxz7jw0)
* Click on Lighting
* Type/search "boholmen"

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**

It should still show other matching categories as a way to allow the user to have more context.

**Feature: What is the proposed solution?**

Switch from hierarchical facet to disjunctive facet in the menu implementation.
